name: Client onboarding keeps website planning simple
description: The client confirms business facts and services while LaunchLoom handles website planning and public market research.

planSteps.description: Open a valid unused test invitation link, complete Business with fictional details, and continue to Services
Confirm up to five services, choose a business category, enter the main city and usual travel distance, then continue
No client-facing fields ask for search phrases, keyword difficulty, competitor URLs, priority locations, or other SEO strategy
The Services step says LaunchLoom will learn about the local market and plan the website after submission
